services: Mortgage, refinance, home building, auto, recreational, secured, and commercial loan options.
Small business checking, business credit cards, commercial loans, SBA loans, equipment loans, real estate construction and take-out loans.

audiences: Small business owners and business members.

service_area: NCUSO profile lists 20 branch locations as of 2025-09-30.
confirmed_facts.hours: Official wire-transfer page says wire requests can be initiated by phone on weekdays from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; branch or operations-center lobby access should be confirmed directly.
differentiators: Member-owned and governed by a member-elected volunteer board.
Official about page says it serves more than 180,000 members across Arizona.
trust_signals: Routing number 322172797 is published on official pages.
NCUSO lists the institution as a federally insured state-chartered credit union.
Official contact pages provide accessibility and secure online banking notices.
products: Auto, recreational, secured, mortgage, home equity, SBA, commercial, equipment, and construction loans.
Mobile banking, online banking, Zelle, mobile deposit, debit cards, and wire transfers.
pricing_notes: Official wire page lists domestic outgoing wire fees at $20 in person or $25 by phone; incoming domestic wires have no fee.
Official wire page lists international outgoing wire fee at $50 and says international wires are available for business accounts only.
Product rates, account fees, loan rates, and insurance pricing vary by product and should be checked on current official rate and disclosure pages.
